Rediscovery of Love () is an upcoming South Korean television series starring Kim So-yeon. It is scheduled to be broadcast on JTBC.
Synopsis
Cast and characters
* Kim So-yeon
Production
Development
Originally titled Rediscovery of Divorce (), the title was changed to Rediscovery of Love, sparking curiosity about the plot. In April 2026, the production is already underway, targeting a September release. A JTBC official told Xportsnews, "We're discussing the broadcast schedule."
Casting
In April 2026, Kim So-yeon had been cast.
